messages:
Ethan (AE): Sales ask: customer wants BCP/DR bits for SIG: RTO/RPO numbers, backup cadence, restore evidence, and failover steps. Need short answers + one runbook excerpt.

Riya (Security): I'll draft. Call out Hosted vs Dedicated/Private and encryption at rest/in-transit.

Derek (SRE): Facts to use: control plane metadata replicated across AZs; WAL shipping to geo-standby; object-store snapshots hourly, nightly fulls; default retention 30d.

Riya (Security): Draft SIG lines: Hosted — Multi-AZ + geo-standby with encrypted snapshots. Control-plane RTO objective: <= 1 hour. Persisted data RPO: ~15 minutes (WAL + snapshots). Dedicated/Private — RTO/RPO configurable via SOW.

Derek (SRE): Failover summary: health checks -> routing switch -> promote standby. DNS failover for region loss; routing change typically 1–5 min. Restore testing: quarterly full restore drills; can provide scrubbed logs/screenshots.

Hannah (Legal): SLA wording suggestion: "Hosted: 99.9% monthly uptime SLA; Dedicated: 99.95% (per contract). Remedies subject to SLA terms and exclusions." Keep SIG conservative.

Derek (SRE): Runbook excerpt to attach:

```
Failover test excerpt
1) Notify #eng-oncall and set maintenance flag
2) Trigger: switch routing to standby region
3) Smoke: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api-standby.redwood.ai/health
4) Validate replication lag < 30s and sample queries succeed
5) Re-sync primary from backups and monitor
Evidence: attach logs/screenshots and timestamped runbook entry
```

DR Bot: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/dr-tests/overview (last full restore: 2025-06-09).

Ethan (AE): Perfect — I'll upload to the SIG spreadsheet and ask for scrubbed artifacts.

Riya (Security): I'll pull and redact logs, upload within 24h.

Hannah (Legal): LGTM. Avoid hard guarantees outside contracts. :white_check_mark:

Ethan (AE): Thanks team — sending now.
